sections.title: Prerequisites: Vectors as Areas
lecture_lines: Area equals the absolute determinant value.
animations: Draw two vectors starting from origin in #FFFFFF.
Create a parallelogram by connecting the vector tips with dashed lines in #FFFF00.
Fill the parallelogram area with semi-transparent #00FFFF and display area label.

sections.title: The Linear System as a Geometric Transformation
lecture_lines: We find weights to reach b.
animations: Transform the grid using a 2x2 matrix to show shearing/scaling in #FF00FF.
Outline a unit square and its transformed version to show area change, labeled as Det(A) in #00FF00.

sections.title: Geometric Derivation of Cramer's Rule
lecture_lines: Replacing a column creates new parallelograms.
Variable equals new area over old area.
This ratio solves for each coordinate.
animations: Visualize the system Ax=b as vector scaling of columns in #FFFFFF.
Highlight the column being replaced by vector b with a distinct color #FFD700.
Animate the transformed parallelogram with the replaced column in #FF00FF.
Overlay the ratio of the new area over the original area in #00FF00.
Show equality of ratio to the solution component in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Visual Synthesis & Intuition
animations: Overlay the transformed unit square area over the determinant value in #FFFF00.
Trace vectors moving to reach point b in #00FFFF.
Flicker area ratios and coordinates to show them aligning in #00FF00.

sections.title: Summary and Constraint
animations: Show a non-zero determinant condition check in #00FF00.
Transition to collinear vectors resulting in zero area (zero determinant) in #FF0000.
Fade in text summarizing the requirement for unique solutions in #FFFFFF.
